about: Fixture set for the What We Heard prompt (heard-draft@1), from the fictional Riverside engagement. Each case has the inputs discover_heard_claim hands the worker (accepted themes only, under refs), the reply recorded for the fake client, and what the headlines may and may not contain. The recorded reply is checked against the expectations always.
